content: शिव {%a.%} [श्यति पापं शो-वन् पृषो˚] .²1 Auspicious, propitious, lucky; इयं शिवाया नियतेरिवायतिः <ls>Ki. 4. 21</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">1. 38</ls>; <ls>R. 11. 33</ls>. .²2 In good health or condition, happy, prosperous, fortunate; तीर्थेन मूर्ध्न्यधिकृतेन शिवः शिवोऽभूत् <ls>Bhāg. 3. 28. 22</ls>; शिवानि वस्तीर्थजलानि कच्चित् <ls>R. 5. 8</ls> (= अनुपप्लवानि, ‘undisturbed’); शिवास्ते पन्थानः सन्तु ‘a happy journey to you’, ‘God bless (or speed) you on your journey’. .{@-वः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the third god of the sacred Hindu Trinity, who is entrusted with the work of destruction, as Brahman and Viṣṇu are with the creation and preservation, of the world; एको देवः केशवो वा शिवो वा <ls>Bh. 2. 115</ls>. .²2 The male organ of generation, penis. .²3 An auspicious planetary conjunction. .²4 The Veda; अट्टशूलाः जनपदाः शिवशूलाश्चतुष्पथाः <ls>Mb. 3. 188. 42</ls>. .²5 Final beatitude. .²6 A post to which cattle are tied. .²7 A god, deity. .²8 Quick-silver. .²9 Bdellium. .²10 The black variety of thorn-apple. .²11 Rum, spirit. .²12 Buttermilk. .²13 A ruby. .²14 Time (काल). .{@-वौ@} ({%m.%} dual) Śiva and Pārvatī; कथयति शिवयोः शरीरयोगं विषमपदा पदवी विवर्तनेषु <ls>Ki. 5. 40</ls>. .{@-वम्@} .²1 Prosperity, welfare, well-being, happiness; तं धर्मेऽग्निषु पुत्रेषु शिवं पृष्ट्वा <ls>Rām. 7. 33. 13</ls>; तव वर्त्मनि वर्ततां शिवम् <ls>N. 2. 62</ls>; <ls>Ratn. 1. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 60</ls>. .²2 Bliss, auspiciousness. .²3 Final beatitude. .²4 Water. .²5 Seasalt. .²6 Rock-salt. .²7 Refined borax. .²8 Iron. .²9 Myrobalan. .²10 Sandal. .{@-बी(वी)जम्@} quick-silver.
